summary: Antonelli's homecoming ignites Monza as Ferrari hunts Mercedes, with the Scuderia's upgraded engine closing the straight-line gap but still falling short of full parity heading into Italy's spiritual battleground. Hamilton and Mercedes defend their power-unit advantage while Ferrari's package evolution tests whether incremental gains suffice on Monza's high-speed demands, where slipstreaming and DRS overtakes remain paramount. A Ferrari victory would reshape championship momentum in front of the Tifosi, potentially upending the title narrative with four rounds remaining.
